title: Shadowing Minutes and Pronunciation Consistency
dataSources: Lessons (`lesson:complete`), vocab reviews (`vocab:review`), immersion (`immersion:log`), speaking practice (`speaking:session`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Duolingo / Babbel lesson exports, Anki spaced-repetition review logs, immersion trackers, and speaking-practice logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=speaking:session exercise=shadowing
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(minutes) as shadow_minutes, avg(pronunciation_score) as avg_pronunciation by _time language
| sort 0 _time language
description: Trends shadowing practice minutes alongside a pronunciation score to show whether the work is paying off.
value: Pronunciation improves through consistent repetition; this links effort with measured speaking quality.
implementation: Log shadowing exercises and a pronunciation score in `speaking:session`; trend weekly by language.
visualization: Dual-axis line chart of shadowing minutes and pronunciation score.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces how much shadowing practice you do and whether your pronunciation is getting steadier because of it.
